body: claimed: Codex (skull) · 2026-11-22T19:25Z · branch mkinney:issue/3554-tilted-hole-pin · plan: write a test with holes tilted 2 and 5 degrees, run it on main, then fix or keep it as a pin

Looks already fixed on upstream/main 6e641dac7: the test below passes without a change. Suggest closing; the maintainer decides.

What the test does (`crates/motion/src/drilling/tests_tilted.rs`, branch `mkinney:issue/3554-tilted-hole-pin`, commit 418e88034):

- `tilted_wall_builder_at_zero_tilt_is_a_z_hole`: the mesh builder at 0 degrees gives one Z hole. This shows that the fixture is correct.
- `tilted_holes_in_a_plate_are_not_drilled_along_z`: a 10 mm plate has one hole tilted 2 degrees and one tilted 5 degrees. `recognize` finds no Z hole. `recognize_cross` finds no cross hole. The test also tries 1, 2 and 8 bands and -2 degrees. All give no Z hole.
- `a_tilt_the_fit_accepts_moves_no_wall_past_fit_tol`: thin walls (0.3 mm to 3 mm) with a small tilt. When the fit accepts one as a Z hole, each wall vertex is within `FIT_TOL` (0.02 mm) of the found circle.

Why the hypothesis is false:

- The circle fit in `classify` (`recognize.rs`) uses all wall vertices, from the top and the bottom of the hole.
- The tilt moves the section centre by depth x tan(angle). For 2 degrees over 10 mm, this is 0.35 mm. The fit then has a residual near 0.17 mm. This is far above `FIT_TOL`, so the fit refuses the wall.
- The ellipse error (about 0.0006 r) is not the controlling term. The axial slide is.
- A short tilted hole can pass. Then `FIT_TOL` limits the wall movement to 0.02 mm. This is the same tolerance that each tessellated hole has.

Mutation: with `FIT_TOL` set to 0.5, `tilted_holes_in_a_plate_are_not_drilled_along_z` fails. With 0.02 it passes. The pin guards the fit.

The fit residual check is on main since 2458afc69 / 5f9294fb3 (M4.1, M5.0.1). No later commit changed it for this case.

The issue asks to keep the test as a pin. The branch above has it. A PR can take it if the maintainer wants it. A tilted hole is dropped with no named message. A named skip is a separate enhancement, not a gouge.

I release my claim.
